none: PAS YORYM-89B756: Roman Coin : Sestertius of Severus Alexander
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A thin disc copying a possible sestertius of Severus Alexander dating to the period AD 222 - 235 (Reece Period 11). The reverse of the coin depicts the impressed obverse details and four possible casting spurs project at equidistant points from the edge of the disc. DESCRIPTION: Laureate head right. INSCRIPTION: IMP ALEXANDER PIVS AVG
